source.name: Permanent Service for Mean Sea Level (PSMSL), RLR monthly means

method: Each dot is the point answer for its spot (/api/trend for sea level at the dot), from the gauge's monthly mean sea level: each month minus that calendar month's 1995–2014 average (the fitted seasonal cycle where the record has no such average), then the Mann-Kendall test and Sen's slope over the whole record from start to end (sparse early years left out, as the point answer does), with the 95% range widened for months that are alike. Rates are relative to the land at the gauge, in mm a year, to 0.1. A dot whose record the point answer would not use, or whose spot is answered by another gauge, is in skipped. Stats are plain counts of gauges, not weighted by area or coastline; percentiles are the lowest rate with at least that share of gauges at or below it.
